lines.ja: デミカツ丼……えびめし……ばら寿司……
lines.en: Demi-katsu bowls... shrimp-meshi... barazushi...

lines.ja: 九月。梨ヶ坂市役所・地下。
lines.en: September. Nashigasaka City Hall, the basement.

lines.ja: 仕事中に食べ物の話をしない！
lines.en: No food talk on the job!

lines.ja: このきびだんご、経費ですか
lines.en: Are these kibi dango on expenses?

lines.ja: 岡山は名物だらけでいいよなァ！
lines.en: Okayama's got famous food everywhere. Lucky them!

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂には、何もねえ！
lines.en: Nashigasaka's got NOTHING!

lines.ja: 本庁から、宿題を持ち帰りました
lines.en: I brought homework back from the main building.

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂の名物グルメを、作れと……
lines.en: We're to create a signature Nashigasaka dish...

lines.ja: 本庁に成果を見せるチャンス！
lines.en: A chance to show the main building results!

lines.ja: 窓口で困っていた方も、お連れしました
lines.en: I also brought someone who came to the counter for help.

lines.ja: 売れない梨が、山ほどあるんだよ
lines.en: I've got a mountain of pears nobody will buy.

lines.ja: 傷のある梨は、店に出せないんだよ
lines.en: Shops won't take pears with a scratch on them.

lines.ja: 毎年、畑の一割が捨てられてね……
lines.en: Every year a tenth of the orchard gets thrown out...

lines.ja: 味は同じなのに、もったいなくて
lines.en: They taste just the same. Such a waste.

lines.ja: ジャムにする？　でも、誰が作って売るの……
lines.en: Make jam? But who's going to make it and sell it...

lines.ja: ……うめえ
lines.en: ...That's good.

lines.ja: この梨で、梨ヶ坂の名物を作る!!
lines.en: We'll turn these pears into Nashigasaka's signature dish!!

lines.ja: 名前を商標登録すりゃ、使用料ががっぽりだ
lines.en: Register the name as a trademark and the fees roll in.

lines.ja: 一杯売れるごとに、歩合で十円ください
lines.en: Ten yen a bowl as my commission, please.

lines.ja: 商標って、そんなに簡単なの？
lines.en: Is a trademark really that easy?

lines.ja: 任せとけ！　一晩で覚える!!
lines.en: Leave it to me! I'll learn it overnight!!

lines.ja: 同じ名前なら、先に出願した者が勝つ。『先願主義』！
lines.en: Same name? Whoever files first wins. “First to file”!
lines.note: Japan's trademark system is first-to-file: whoever applies first gets the mark, not whoever used it first.

lines.ja: ――その夜。
lines.en: —That night.

lines.ja: 地名と商品名で登録できる……『地域団体商標』!!
lines.en: Place name plus product name can be registered... a “regional collective trademark”!!
lines.note: Regional collective trademarks (e.g. a place name + a product) can only be filed by bodies like co-ops, chambers of commerce or NPOs — never by an individual.

lines.ja: 出願できるのは組合とか……ま、細けえことはいい！
lines.en: Only co-ops and such can file... eh, details!

lines.ja: 先に出したもん勝ちだァーッ!!
lines.en: Whoever files first WINS!!

lines.ja: デミカツ丼、うめえェ!!
lines.en: This demi-katsu bowl is AMAZING!!

lines.ja: 週末。岡山。
lines.en: The weekend. Okayama.

lines.ja: えびめし、黒いのにうめえ!!
lines.en: The shrimp-meshi's black, and it's AMAZING!!

lines.ja: ばら寿司、具が多すぎる!!
lines.en: This barazushi has WAY too many toppings!!

lines.ja: 名物はな、町のみんなで何十年も育てたんじゃ
lines.en: A local dish is somethin' the whole town grew over decades.

lines.ja: 名前さえ取りゃ、こっちのもんだ
lines.en: Once I've got the name, it's mine.

lines.ja: 梨のデミソース……『梨デミカツ丼』だ!!
lines.en: Pear demi-glace... the “Pear Demi-Katsu Bowl”!!

lines.ja: 梨デミカツ丼、あがりィ！
lines.en: One Pear Demi-Katsu Bowl, coming up!

lines.ja: 十月。梨ヶ坂の商店街。
lines.en: October. Nashigasaka's shopping street.

lines.ja: 梨の甘みで、ソースがまろやか!!
lines.en: The pear makes the sauce so mellow!!

lines.ja: 捨ててた梨が、全部使われてる……
lines.en: The pears we threw out... every one gets used...

lines.ja: 出願も済んだ！　名前はおれのもんだ!!
lines.en: And I've filed! The name is MINE!!

lines.ja: 一杯十円、一杯十円……
lines.en: Ten yen a bowl, ten yen a bowl...

lines.ja: 商店街のみんなも、出したいってよ
lines.en: The whole shopping street wants to serve it too.

lines.ja: いいぜ。一杯百円の使用料でな
lines.en: Sure. For a hundred yen a bowl in fees.

lines.ja: 名物は町のみんなのものでしょ!?
lines.en: A local dish belongs to the whole town!

lines.ja: 出願したのは、おれだ!!
lines.en: I'M the one who filed!!

lines.ja: テツさん、特許庁から封筒が来てますよ
lines.en: Tetsu, there's an envelope from the Patent Office.

lines.ja: あとで、あとで！
lines.en: Later, later!

lines.ja: 拒絶理由通知……出願できるのは組合や商工会！
lines.en: Notice of reasons for refusal... only co-ops and chambers of commerce may file!
lines.note: A “notice of reasons for refusal” is the Patent Office's letter saying why an application can't be registered as filed.

lines.ja: こ、個人はダメなのォ!?
lines.en: I-individuals CAN'T!?

lines.ja: 歩合はきちんともらいます
lines.en: I'll still be collecting my commission.

lines.ja: 使用料百円って、どういうことだ!!
lines.en: What's this hundred-yen fee about!!

lines.ja: 名物が、取り合いになっちまった……
lines.en: Now everyone's fighting over the local dish...

lines.ja: 商店街の皆さんから、本庁にお電話がありました
lines.en: The shopping street called the main building.

lines.ja: 皆さま、大変申し訳ございません
lines.en: Everyone, we are deeply sorry.

lines.ja: 源田くん。……いえ、源田さん
lines.en: Genda. ...I mean, Mr. Genda.
lines.note: The boss switches from “Genda-kun” to “Genda-san”. When he gets polite, it's over.

lines.ja: 表彰状。名物は、育てるものです
lines.en: A certificate of commendation. A local dish is something you grow.

lines.ja: 副賞は、屋台の皿洗い一年分です
lines.en: The bonus prize: one year of washing dishes at the food stall.

lines.ja: 組合で、地域団体商標を出願したぜ！
lines.en: We filed a regional collective trademark through the co-op!

lines.ja: ――翌年の秋。梨ヶ坂の秋祭り。
lines.en: —The next autumn. Nashigasaka's autumn festival.

lines.ja: 梨がね、毎日売り切れだよ
lines.en: The pears sell out every day now.

lines.ja: 本庁から、表彰の連絡が来た！
lines.en: The main building says we're getting an award!

lines.ja: 大盛りは『テツ盛り』って名前にしたぞ！
lines.en: I named the large size the “Tetsu Special”!

lines.ja: し、使用料は!?
lines.en: Wh-what about the fee!?

lines.ja: ゼロです
lines.en: Zero.
